name: sustained
description: Continuous load: three of the tallest footprints (spaced 2 x radius, as record-city-trace --demolish-buildings 3 picks them) demolished 15 s (900 ticks) apart, so the stream never gets an idle stretch to recover in. Mirrors scripts/netlab/scenarios.py 'sustained' (wedge 55 deg, jitter 0.35, radius 36 m, below-y 30 m, 2 rounds per tick, stagger 900 ticks) with a 50 s action window instead of 90 s. On the default city each 36 m wedge reaches into neighbouring buildings too.
